## Design contract

<!-- Owned by the build, not by folk. Later edits read this to stay on-system,
     so be specific: a vague contract guarantees drift. -->

**Scope.** Product checkout is Paystack only, behind the `paystack_enabled` flag (off by default). With the flag off, checkout shows "Online payment opens soon" with a WhatsApp button and records a `pending` order with no payment taken. CashApp, Zelle, PayPal and Venmo are not checkout methods. They appear only as send-to handles on `/send-money`, which is a separate page for sending USD abroad that is paid out in cedis in Ghana.

**Tokens.** Forest `#0B2A1B` (iPhone surfaces, primary text blocks), Lime `#B8F23A` (accent on dark, CTA on dark), Royal `#1F4FD6` (services and primary links), Navy `#0A1F4E` (pressed/services depth), Canvas `#F4F6F2` (page), Surface `#FFFFFF`, Hairline `#DDE3DA`, Ink `#0A1A12`, Muted `#4D5E55`. Display and body: Archivo (`@fontsource/archivo` 400/600/800). Utility: IBM Plex Mono 500 (refs, eyebrows, handles). Layout: mobile bottom tab bar (Home, Shop, Cart with count, Support), md+ top bar; 2-column hero on md. Signature element: the forest card with lime CTA, and the reference code set in mono. Brand banners come from `/marc-banners/*.jpg`.

**Simplicity.** Storefront reveals the category row and featured picks first; the full service list sits below. Shop filters live in a disclosure that expands under the search (`height` spring) and collapse when closed. Product variants (condition for iPhones, tier for subscriptions) are a row of links that morph the active ring between options. Checkout asks payment only after details; the screenshot control appears in an expanding panel once a manual method is chosen. Admin is a single login, then four tabs. Product add/edit opens as a bottom sheet on mobile, a centred dialog above sm.

**Fluidity.** One spring for everything: `stiffness 380, damping 34` for page and panel motion, `stiffness 520, damping 38` for selection rings. `layoutId="nav-pill"` travels between bottom tabs. `layoutId="cat-pill"` travels between shop categories. `layoutId="variant-ring"` travels between product variants. `layoutId="pay-ring"` travels between payment methods. `layoutId="admin-tab"` travels between admin tabs. `layoutId="product-<slug>"` is set on the product image so it can travel from a card into detail (cards not yet linked, reserved for that). Cart item exit slides out left with layout reflow. Directional page transitions use a short rise on enter and fall on exit. Reduced motion collapses travel to opacity via `useReducedMotion`.

**Delight.** Tier 1 (constant): the cart badge springs when the count changes; the subtotal and price numbers slide in when they change; quantity digits fade up on change. Tier 2: sonner toast on add-to-cart; the "Added" state on the add button. Tier 3 (rare, one moment): the order confirmation check springs in with overshoot on a fresh placement, with the reference set in mono. Surprise is hidden in the "Your trust, our reputation" line on the home page contact block. No confetti in this app.
